title: AATIP as part of a government disclosure effort

tellings.quote: mean as recent as like 2015 16 I mean ATIP was certainly part of that effort.

plain: Jake Barber, a man who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter, says that as recently as 2015 and 2016 AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, was part of a wider government effort to slowly make public what it knows about UFOs. If true, it would mean that office was not only studying sightings but helping prepare the public.
